Build the Great Pyramid: square base 14x14 studs, at least 7 tiers stepping in evenly to a peak, in tan, with one side carrying a small entrance opening at ground level. Center the tiers exactly. 130-280 parts.
Constraints: footprint must fit within 16x16 studs; height at least 140 LDU (6 bricks); use at least 120 parts.
